## GET /v1/linkme/page - 1 credit (standard)

Returns data from a Linkme page including display name, bio, avatar, and list of links with titles and URLs.

**Use when** you want it for link.me pages; Linktree, lnk.bio, Komi, and Pillar pages each have their own endpoint.
**Cost** cache 900 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `url` (required) - Full URL of the Linkme page · e.g. `https://link.me/example`

**Response** `Author` object at `data`, `{ author, computed }` ([full schema](schemas/Author.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `author.id` | Platform-specific user ID… |
| `author.username` | User handle or username |
| `author.avatar_url` | URL to profile picture |
| `author.bio` | Profile biography or description |
| `author.display_name` | Display name or full name |
| `author.followers` | Follower or subscriber count as an integer. |

+6 more fields in the full schema. Never filled: `author._links`, `author.following`, `author.likes_count`, `author.url`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/linkme/page" \
  --data-urlencode "url=https://link.me/example" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
